name: Enemy Rebalance
description: Regular Bile Titans take full explosion damage. Impaler head: 900 HP; leg flesh: 500 HP. Alpha Warrior movement speed -20%. Alpha Commander summon cooldown: 35-45 seconds, up from 15-20 seconds. Elevated Overseer armor HP -25%; Crescent Overseer armor HP -50%. Charger braking uses the updated live-game animation. The raised-rear recovery pause lasts half a second longer. Eligible Automaton projectile weapons have 25% wider horizontal and vertical spread. Tanks, Factory Striders and Cyborgs retain their existing spread.
